subject: PO requirement exemption request — FluxNova pilot & evidence
messages:
From: Sophie Leung <sophie@fluxnova.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fluxnova.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path

Hi Karthik and Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the FluxNova team is excited to start the 90-day pilot with Redwood. Our legal and finance teams are working through the standard onboarding questions; before they complete the portal intake we wanted to ask whether Redwood can make an exception to the PO mandate for this pilot.

Short version: we are a small startup and the procurement cycle on our side is slow. We propose invoice-only billing for the pilot (monthly invoices) while we finish the onboarding forms and provide the usual evidence (W-9, SOW, SOC2 summary). Pilot committed spend is estimated at $18k over 90 days.

Attached: FluxNova_Initial_SOW.pdf (draft), FluxNova_W9.pdf, FluxNova_Invoice_SAMPLE.pdf

What we need from Redwood: confirmation that an invoice-only path is acceptable temporarily and a short list of required artifacts to speed procurement on our end. If there's a form or a single-approver gate we can aim for it. If a PO exception requires procurement committee signoff, please let us know the expected timeline.

Appreciate any flexibility here — happy to hop on a 20-minute call to walk procurement through the reasoning.

Best,
Sophie Leung
Head of Finance, FluxNova Inc
Sophie.leung@fluxnova.com
Attachments: FluxNova_Initial_SOW.pdf, FluxNova_W9.pdf, FluxNova_Invoice_SAMPLE.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Leung <sophie@fluxnova.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path

Hi Sophie — thanks for the materials and the clear ask. Copying Priyom and Laura from procurement and billing to help triage. A few clarifying questions so we can evaluate the exception quickly:

- Total pilot value and invoicing cadence: you mentioned ~$18k over 90 days — is that one invoice at the end, or monthly invoices?
- Billing entity and tax documents: the W-9 you sent looks good; is that the final legal name for invoicing?
- Data/residency and compliance: will any production customer data be processed during the pilot (we just need to know if this triggers stricter onboarding steps)?
- SLA/rollback: if we need to suspend service mid-pilot for compliance reasons, are you ok with a pro-rated refund?

Internally: procurement has a temporary path we can use for pilots under $25k if the evidence pack is complete (W-9, signed SOW, responsible billing contact, and a short security questionnaire). That path still requires a one-off approval from the procurement committee chair but avoids creating a PO upfront — instead, we allow invoice-only for a 90-day trial with pre-agreed work/metrics.

If you can confirm monthly invoices and the legal entity, Priyom can create the checklist and send the approval packet to the procurement chair. If we need faster movement I can approve an interim exception subject to Priyom's checklist.

Happy to join a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: none

From: Sophie Leung <sophie@fluxnova.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@fluxnova.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 08:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path

Hi Karthik — thanks for the quick reply. Answers below:

- Invoicing cadence: monthly invoices, due net 30. Estimated monthly invoice ~ $6k.
- Billing entity: FluxNova Inc (EIN 12-3456789) — W-9 is final.
- Data/residency: pilot will use synthetic and anonymized datasets only; no PII or customer production data. We will sign the short security questionnaire.
- Refund: monthly invoices are fine; if we must pause, we accept pro-rated adjustments.

We appreciate the pilot path you referenced. Please loop in whatever documentation is needed and we'll get it back same day. For the procurement chair approval, can you provide expected lead time? Our finance lead is on a short timeline to close this trial with our board this month.

Also: would Redwood be amenable to holding pricing for a 6-month window post-pilot if we convert? Just a clarifying negotiation point.

Best,
Sophie
Attachments: FluxNova_W9.pdf (again), FluxNova_Initial_SOW.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Leung <sophie@fluxnova.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 11:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path

Hi Sophie and team — thanks for the prompt answers and the attachments. From a procurement operations standpoint here's what we need to move an invoice-only pilot through our temporary exception lane: 

Required evidence (upload to our vendor portal):
- Completed W-9 (received)
- Signed SOW (received draft; please sign and return)
- Short security questionnaire (I will send the link; answers due within 48 hours)
- Primary billing contact and billing email (please confirm billing@fluxnova.com)
- Direct invoice PDF sample (received)

Operational notes:
- Committee approval: our procurement chair typically reviews these packets within 48 business hours once the portal upload is complete. If all docs are in order we can issue a temporary exception that allows invoice-only billing for up to 90 days and tags the account as "pilot-no-po".
- Controls: invoices will be routed through our billing team for PO-free approval and will sit under a weekly review for spend vs. SOW. We will not create a PO during the exception but will require a signed conversion commitment if you convert to a subscription after the pilot.
- Pricing hold: we can offer a 90-day price hold after conversion (not 6 months) as a standard concession for pilot converts. If you need 6 months, that needs explicit approval from Finance; we can include that request in the packet.

Next steps: Sophie, please upload the signed SOW and complete the short questionnaire at the link below. Once I confirm the upload I'll route to the procurement chair. If the board timeline is tight, flag that in the portal comments and Karthik can escalate.

Portal link: https://redwoodinc.sharepoint.com/sites/procurement/FLX-2026/onboarding
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/FLX-2026 (for sales record)

Thanks — I'll follow up after I receive the portal upload.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Senior Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: none
